extracted.intended_audience: journalists, public relations professionals, and members of the Public Relations Society of America
extracted.subtask_description: A short organizational press release announcing the election of an association president and related officers, including quotes, program intentions, membership and financial context. Useful as an exemplar of how to report organizational election news to the press and public.

rubrics_metrics.name: Headline / Title
rubrics_metrics.description: PRSA ASSEMBLY ELECTS WOLCOTT AS PRESIDENT
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Place the principal news (who + what) prominently as a concise headline. In this example the headline states the organization (PRSA), the body responsible (Assembly), the action (elects), and the person (Wolcott).

rubrics_metrics.name: Dateline / Date / Place indication
rubrics_metrics.description: …at the annual meeting of the Society's Assembly of Delegates held in New York City, Saturday (Nov. 20).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include where and when the event occurred (city, meeting/event, and date). The press release situates the election by naming the annual meeting, city, and exact date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lead paragraph summarizing core facts
rubrics_metrics.description: Robert B. Wolcott, Jr., president, Robert B. Wolcott Associates, Inc., Los Angeles, was elected 1966 president of the Public Relations Society of America …
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Open with a compact lede that answers the basic news questions: who was elected, their current title/affiliation, what position they will hold, and at which event the election occurred. The first paragraph should carry the essential facts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identification of individuals with titles and affiliations
rubrics_metrics.description: Uses full name plus title and organization (e.g., 'Robert B. Wolcott, Jr., president, Robert B. Wolcott Associates, Inc., Los Angeles').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Always provide the elected person's full name, current title, employer/firm/university and city to establish credibility and context. Repeat this format for other officers and directors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quotations or statement of intent from the principal
rubrics_metrics.description: Mr. Wolcott said he hopes to spend his year in office … 'We should articulate all sides of a major public issue,' he stated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a short quote or summary of the incoming leader's priorities or plans to convey direction and voice. This can introduce a named program or initiative (e.g., 'Program for Responsible Service to America').

rubrics_metrics.name: Listing of additional officers and directors elected
rubrics_metrics.description: Other officers elected at the meeting included J. Carroll Bateman … vice-president; James G. Shea … secretary. John H. Sattler … re-elected treasurer. Elected to the PRSA directors were Edwin E. Dowell … and Edward P. VonderHaar …
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a clear list of other officers and board members with names and titles; sequence by office (vice-president, secretary, treasurer, directors). This documents organizational continuity and leadership team composition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organizational context and membership information
rubrics_metrics.description: …election to head the 5,100 member organization … The PRSA National Eligibility Committee reported moves whereby the Society will be more selective in granting membership. 'As you know, the Society is attempting to constantly upgrade the kind of new people admitted to membership … 19 applicants were turned down this year.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include relevant background facts about the organization's size, membership standards, and any policy changes that bear on the significance of the announcement. Use specific numbers and committee actions to add substance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Financial or operational status disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: It was reported that the Society's financial status at the end of October showed total gross receipts of $393,270.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When relevant, report financial figures or operational status to provide context about organizational health; include time frame (e.g., 'at the end of October') and exact amounts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Announcement of foundation leadership and related appointments
rubrics_metrics.description: Glen Perry … was elected as president of the Foundation for Public Relations Research and Education. Ward B. Stevenson … was chosen Foundation vice-president.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the organization has affiliated foundations or committees, include their leadership changes to show the broader institutional impact of the meeting and elections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Naming and brief explanation of programs/initiatives
rubrics_metrics.description: Part of his plan … The name for this effort will be Program for Responsible Service to America (taken from the initials of the PR society.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When announcing new programs or initiatives, give the program name and a concise explanation of its purpose or origin to help reporters and stakeholders understand its aims.
